posts.zh:
deepseek-web-import 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。从设置页把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端对话导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，导入后可在其中继续对话。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-103bb0897df395c6e510.html
posts.en:
deepseek-web-import is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-103bb0897df395c6e510.html
